reason: A macOS menu bar utility that manages the local dsh web service with launchd, including service control, local Web UI access, package installation and updates, startup configuration, and log management.

summaries.zh: 一款 macOS 菜单栏工具，用于通过 launchd 管理本地 dsh Web 服务，并提供启动、停止、更新和打开 Web UI 等操作。
summaries.en: A macOS menu bar utility for managing a local dsh web service through launchd, with controls for starting, stopping, updating, and opening its Web UI.

capabilities: Starts, stops, restarts, and monitors a local dsh web service through macOS launchd
Installs and updates the @deepseek-ai/dsh npm package
Opens the local web interface in a browser
Reads and writes local launchd configuration, application data, and log files
Queries the npm registry for available dsh versions
